name: claude_p10_sort_merge_restart (B09 kill-and-reload during unit moves; NOT RUN; needs the observation requests in _requests)
classification: FIXTURE-DEPENDENT; REQUIRES NEW READ-ONLY OBSERVATIONS AND A reload STEP; asserts real container cells, worker bag, saved credit rows and outcomes, never log lines
_requests: All requests of claude_p10_sort_merge.json (expectContainerCells, expectNpcBag, expectB09Outcomes, b09policy, b09gates, b09dispatch, fillcontainer)

expectB09Credit {npc:class,phaseAtLeast:N,merge:bool} : read-only over RebirthNpcWorkNativeCreditOriginal.TryReadSaved(npc, RebirthNpcStorageOrganizationWork.CreditOperation(assignmentId)) fields Phase, Attempted, Published, Merge, DestinationSlot, plus RebirthNpcWorkNativeTransferOriginal.TryReadSaved(npc, DeriveOperationId(assignmentId)).Phase
killAfterPhase {npc,transferPhase|creditPhase:N} : a run-until-saved-phase wait (waitFor on expectB09Credit) followed by reload
reload : runner step that quits the game process without rebuilding and relaunches into the same CodexTest save (bridge 'restart' rebuilds), then waits for state=ingame

steps.console: b09policy set npc=$NPC container=20,45,995 sort=ByName merge=1 sortWithin=1 enabled=1 confirm=CodexTest

steps._note: Unit move 2 is a MERGE credit (0->2 M). Kill at four points: (a) transfer phase 1 saved (debit not applied), (b) transfer phase 4 saved (unit only in the worker bag), (c) credit phase 3 saved (write-ahead intent, destination not yet written), (d) credit phase 4 saved (destination written, bag not cleared).
Credit phase 3 saved: reload now. Before reload, record unit totals; after reload every unit must be in the container or the NPC bag and the move must complete exactly once.
Mid-stack interruption: continue to move 4/5 and reload between the plain unit (2->1 P) and its merge (2->1 M): layout [A1,B1,B1] must be re-planned and finish as [A1,B2,_].
